title: Inference-horizon quant preset engine and safety lattice for per-model defaults
creator: Priya Raman
description:
Goal: Ship a deterministic engine that suggests a per-model default quantization profile (FP8/INT8 presets) in the model catalog along with a safety lattice and an automated calibration + accuracy-validation workflow. The engine should produce a primary recommended profile, a ranked set of safe fallbacks, and a rollout plan that ties into shadow validation and CI gating.

Scope:
- Catalog metadata: store default_profile, fallback_chain, confidence_band, and calibration_artifact pointers.
- Preset engine: heuristic + ML-based scorer that consumes model characteristics (architecture, layer-wise sensitivity, ops mix), sample dataset fingerprints, and historical eval signals to produce recommended FP8/INT8 presets.
- Calibration pipeline: standardized calibration harness that produces calibration tables, activation ranges, and per-layer stats.
- Accuracy validation: evaluation harness for representative prompts/datasets with threshold-based gating and a shadow-run mode for rollout.
- Guardrails: safety lattice (hard restrictions on classes of models/workloads), rollback/fallback policy, and CI checks that prevent large quality regressions.
- Observability: telemetry and dashboards surfaced in Console for precision-related regressions and rollout metrics.

Non-goals: automatic model re-quantization in production without explicit rollout; per-request dynamic precision switching (out of scope for this ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Model catalog exposes a default_profile field and fallback_chain for at least the 50 highest-traffic models in the catalog.
Preset engine produces reproducible recommendations for FP8 and INT8 with a confidence_band metric for each recommendation.
Calibration pipeline runs as a standalone job and uploads calibration artifacts (tables, ranges, per-layer deltas) to artifact storage with deterministic metadata tags.
Accuracy-validation harness executes shadow runs and stops rollout if end-to-end metric degradation > 1.5% absolute on primary benchmarks or > 5% on any safety-related metric.
CI gating added: any change to a model's default_profile must include a shadow validation report and sign-off from an owner before rollout to runtime-1.21.
Console shows a precision dashboard with per-model baseline vs quantized accuracy, token-cost delta, and active rollouts.
Rollback path validated: automatic fallback to first safe profile in fallback_chain within 3 minutes of detected regression during staged rollout.
